title: Verdict on Duterte impeachment trial possible by Dec. 16 – court spox
summary: The Senate impeachment court may reach a verdict in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte by December 16, 2026, its spokesperson Reginald Tongol said Friday.
